capture_source: Joe's Map search behavior report plus verified pre-fix source flow on PR #554
state_server_capture: unavailable: this repository intentionally has no DebugBridge or GET /state/snapshot integration; the deterministic source state and simulator fixture are the regression surface
privacy: No raw user query telemetry, account identity, saved-place content, or precise user location is recorded.

precondition.map_zoom: tighter than the useful nearby search radius

pre_fix.external_search_region: one MapKit request biased to the visible viewport
pre_fix.ranking_origin: viewer GPS when available instead of the panned map center
pre_fix.generic_saved_match: a strong saved category match short-circuits external search on Return
pre_fix.submitted_camera: centers the first result at a fixed span instead of fitting the returned set

expected.external_search_region: start at least at the viewport radius and expand within a bounded regional radius until four useful combined results are available or the cap is reached
expected.external_search_boundary: discard provider results outside the active pass radius because MapKit region is only a hint
expected.generic_saved_match: counts toward the four visible rows but does not prevent external expansion when more results are needed
expected.typeahead_camera: remains unchanged while offscreen suggestions may appear
expected.submitted_camera: fits the retained submitted result set without zooming in, while an explicitly tapped suggestion still centers only that place
expected.named_search: retains regionless exact-name recovery, including single-word names
expected.feed_search: unchanged global rec.me-only retrieval with no proximity bias
